name: W'Kabi, Shield of the Nation
oracle_text:
Vigilance
Whenever you attack with your commander, if you control an artifact with mana value 4 or greater, create a 4/4 green Rhino creature token with trample.
blocked_sentences: Whenever you attack with your commander, if you control an artifact with mana value 4 or greater, create a 4/4 green Rhino creature token with trample.

needs.what: a 4/4 green Rhino creature token with trample
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids is closed and has no Rhino; the nearest 4/4 green tokens (beast_4_4_g, phyrexian_beast_4_4_g) are the wrong creature type and lack trample. The trigger itself is expressible (an `attacks` trigger filtered on is_commander + controller you, with an intervening-if `exists` over artifacts you control with mana_value >= 4), so the token is the only missing piece.
